assessments.reasoning: The instrument does not explicitly ask whether a person supervises or remains available to care for other household members while performing other activities or without care being their main activity. The questionnaire mentions care only as a reason for not seeking work (Pregunta 6), as a status category of inactivity (Pregunta 7), or as a reason for not working more hours (Pregunta 60). Supervisory or passive care concurrent with other activities is not mentioned at all in the text.
